claims.text: When news came from the south of the destruction of Sauron, Bard and Thorin emerged from the Lonely Mountain and broke the siege. Later he sent an ambassador to the crowning of King Elessar and thereafter his kingdom enjoyed the protection of the King of the West.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Great Years"
